data.title: 夕 · 新春画轴挑选
data.description: 【夕 · 新春画轴挑选】暖灯照着室内长廊，夕穿着黑金旗袍和毛边短披肩，站在几幅新挂好的水墨画前。她一手垂握细长烟管，另一手轻扶卷轴下缘，眯起眼判断留白是否合适——「这幅就放这里。空出来的地方，也是画的一部分。」
data.action: 站在画轴前，一手垂握烟管，另一手轻扶画轴下缘
data.promptProse: Dusk studies a newly hung ink painting, one hand steadying the scroll's lower edge while the other loosely holds a slender pipe. Her black-and-gold qipao and fur-edged capelet frame both hands in medium view. Neighboring scrolls extend along the gallery corridor. Warm paper-lamp light reveals the paper grain and rolled edge, casting a thin shadow between the artwork and the wall.
data.camera: medium shot, one hanging scroll and both hands within the frame
data.lighting: 室内纸灯映出画纸纹理的暖光
